visualInspection.referenceViewing: Original and fixed target viewed directly enlarged and each whole canvas reduced to logical 192x320 on light #EFEBE1, gray #7C7C7C and dark #191D24. No silhouette fitting.
visualInspection.sourceStateCoverage: All 192 published original frames inspected through four independently generated state sheets: each four facings x twelve frames, maintaining full-frame registration.
visualInspection.limits: Static source sheets establish per-frame appearance, not temporal playback. No edited candidate exists or is approved. Playback, native motion/contact audits, all-background action checks and hash-bound candidate evidence remain required for candidate review.

sourceObservations: Lena is identifiable by a large rounded-square dark-brown face, chocolate curl cap/fringe, ivory chef toque/coat, bright blue apron and red necktie. These palette and identity cues remain mandatory while modeling can improve.

The original front toque has tall stepped rectangular lobes and almost white unmodulated interiors. At logical size the hat reads as a blank block; N/E/W show similar near-white rectangles and side steps.

Front curls read as a row of similar brown beads. N shows dense stacked dark curl patches with weak soft volume; the back hair hides much of the upper coat. More purposeful grouped curl volume can improve this without exposing a face on the rear.

The original coat sleeves, bib, apron waist and pocket read as separate flat/angular blocks. The tie is visible but mechanically rectangular. The target suggests coherent collar edges, cuffs, a fabric band, a shaped pocket and softer garment transitions.

The friendly eyes, brows and smile remain readable frontally at logical size; side views appropriately show a profile. Small facial relief and cheek color should support this readability rather than enlarge or crowd the face.

Work moves hands forward and tips the torso in the side sheets. Hold and load contain the separate salmon dish image; the plate is naturally hidden behind the north-facing body in the original atlas. A future review must distinguish correct depth occlusion from newly hidden/clipped palms or dish attachments, and require functional evidence beyond a front idle.

Minimal foot ends and a short body are part of the occupied C125 scale. Target shoes and garment proportions are useful design references only within the native height, ground contacts and serving clearance.

valuableOutcomes: Rounded, inflated toque lobes with a continuous soft band and restrained fold valleys.
A cohesive chocolate curl crown/fringe with broad soft highlights and enough value variation to separate overlapping locks.
Warm ivory coat with shaped collar/cuffs and restrained buttons, a clear red scarf knot/tails, and a shaped blue apron/pocket/waist construction.
Gentle rounded facial relief and a friendly expression, using a dark-brown Lena palette.
Soft, warm, even illumination that retains volume on both light fabric and dark curls.
nonAuthority: Target enlarges/repositions the figure within its canvas: no crop, root, height, camera or pose fitting may copy it.
The target skin is visibly more orange/lighter than the original identity; preserve dark-brown Lena skin rather than matching that drift.
The bright perimeter/rim and occasional white fringe are not desired alpha edges or required native highlights.
One front view gives no authority for unseen back/side construction, attachment accuracy or motion.
Target shoe size, exact lobe/lock/button count and every drawn seam are optional; useful native redesign is allowed.

nativeSourceInspection.method: Blender 5.2.2 background load with factory startup and autoexec disabled, querying only Lena structure; no save or re-render.

actions.observed: Native action slots bind to existing Lena owners. Record stores 12 evaluated hand/foot controls per state; this is structural reference, not proof of edited action quality.

nativeSourceInspection.separateDish: Packed dish-salmon.png on a four-vertex fixed-UV transparent image plane. Plane has 55-degree plane rotation to face the 35-degree camera, root-yaw cancellation and camera-ray depth bias. It remains explicitly 2D; the chef and knife are native 3D.
nativeSourceInspection.cameraAuthority: Registered source-camera and atlas guide establish 35-degree character orthographic projection with square pixels; the saved active camera alone is never sufficient authority. Source records carry supersample scale4, while published whole-frame atlases/guide carry sourceScale2. Preserve final 384x640 frames, logical192x320, root96,248 and original atlas layout.
nativeSourceInspection.childFacing: Retain actual authored child/rig/mesh orientation and rest transforms; do not zero or refit child orientation per facing. Source root/armature queries were zero rotation in saved state.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.outcome: Improve native hat, curls and garment construction so rounded volumes and purposeful seams read coherently at logical size in every real facing, retaining Lena identity and functional envelope.
Replace blank ivory/near-black hair patches with soft warm value modeling and restrained broad highlights; keep skin dark brown and colors clear under horizontally balanced lighting.
Carry this quality through all192 native action frames with original registration, action timing, rest structure, hands/dish/knife/belt contacts and clean transparent edges.
